evidence.decision: Decides marking versus control activation and continuous versus discrete input, preserving hover as preview, preference-respecting double tap, and squeeze as a discrete nearby action.
evidence.artifact: Requires tool/input-state behavior covering direct marking, Pencil-specific controls and stable Scribble transcription rather than only describing Pencil features.
evidence.transformation: The diagram example removes a required Pen mode for margin marking, turns committing hover dots into previews, and defers field movement/resizing until a writing pause.
evidence.verification: Checks accidental marks and activation, unstable writing/transcription and unavailable input paths, and correctly reserves latency, palm rejection and physical ergonomics for hardware tests.
evidence.applicability: Limits the workflow to supported iPad/Pencil combinations and distinguishes password fields, custom Scribble support and fixed photo/PDF artwork from adaptable UI appearance.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Gestures for shared manipulation and Typography for field/text behavior, without routing every Pencil task through unrelated topics.
evidence.distinctiveness: Pressure/tilt/roll, nondestructive preference-respecting double tap, squeeze placement, hover nonactivation and stationary Scribble fields produce decisions unique to stylus work.
